meta.title: PandaDev: Learn to code from Zero to Senior
meta.description: Learn JavaScript, Python, TypeScript and more step by step, from your first line of code to senior level, with bite-sized lessons, coding exercises in your browser and real projects.

hero.badge: Learn to code the fun way
hero.description: Master JavaScript, Python, TypeScript and more with bite-sized lessons, real coding exercises and projects. One clear path from your very first line of code to senior developer.

languages.title: Pick a language. <gradient>Start today.</gradient>
languages.description: Every language follows the same four-level path, so you always know what to learn next.

roadmap.title: From <gradient>Zero</gradient> to <cool>Senior</cool>
roadmap.description: Four levels for every language. Each one ends with a capstone project, so you finish with a portfolio, not just notes.

dashboard.title: See yourself <gradient>level up</gradient>
dashboard.description: Earn XP for every lesson, keep your streak alive and watch each language fill up as you go.
dashboard.lessonsAway: You're {count, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} away from finishing Level {level}.

beginners.title: Complete beginners
beginners.text: Never written code? Start at Level 0 with your first line, and practise every idea in an editor right inside the lesson.

students.title: Students
students.text: Go past the syntax with arrays, objects, the DOM, classes and errors, then type-safe code with TypeScript.

developers.title: Working developers
developers.text: Fill the gaps on the way to senior: testing, architecture, performance, security and system design.

cta.title: Ready to write your <gradient>first line of code?</gradient>
